name: @laticent/veduta
description: A windowed preview, headless: which units of a long list a view should mount, at what fidelity and in what order, for a stage and a map beside it. Ranked advisory intent, single, multi and picture-in-picture policies, a fidelity ladder, a page-global live budget, and a capacity the host reports. Works with any focus source; cost does not grow with the list.
author: Sharmarke Aden (Laticent) <sharmarke.aden@gmail.com>
